response.text: The bug was in the `parseRange` function: when given a single number like `"7"` (no hyphen), `text.split("-")` returns `["7"]`, so `to` was `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. The fix checks if a second part exists after the split; if not, it defaults `to` to the same value as `from`.
